Epaned 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-99453  
Guideline Name 
Epaned  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Arizona (AZM, AZMREF, AZMDDD)  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
12/9/2021  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Epaned  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - ONE of the following:  
 
 1.1 Patient is less than 8 years of age  
 
OR 


--- PDF page 576 ---
Page 576 
 
 1.2 BOTH of the following:  
 
  1.2.1 ONE of the following diagnoses:  
• 
Hypertension  
• 
Heart failure  
• 
Asymptomatic left ventricular dysfunction, defined as left ventricular ejection fraction 
less than or equal to 35%  
 
AND 
 
  1.2.2 ONE of the following:  
 
   1.2.2.1 History of failure, contraindication, or intolerance to TWO formulary oral anti-
hypertensives (e.g., angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitor, ACE inhibitor 
combination, angiotensin-receptor blockers (ARB), ARB combination, thiazide diuretic) 
 
OR 
 
   1.2.2.2 Patient is unable to ingest a solid dosage form (e.g. an oral tablet or capsule) due to 
ONE of the following: 
• 
Oral/motor difficulties  
• 
Dysphagia
